title: DoMe entitlement assertion (JWS claims)
description: Compact JWS, alg EdDSA (Ed25519), protected header {alg:'EdDSA', typ:'dome-entitlement+jwt', kid}. Public keys at `<api origin>/.well-known/dome-jwks.json`. Refresh rule: the agent calls POST /v1/agent/entitlement on every connect and at 80% of (exp-iat); a 200 {assertion:null} means Free immediately; the last verified assertion is honoured for at most agent_offline_assertion_grace_hours after exp ONLY when the refresh fails with a network error or 5xx. The relay also pushes a fresh grants_snapshot on plan change.
